transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Arjun. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Arjun, I am absolutely livid. My latest bill is way higher than it should be, and I'm tired of these constant errors!
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you're feeling frustrated with your billing. I can certainly look into this for you.
Agent: Before we dive into the account details, could you please provide your account number and date of birth for verification?
Customer: Fine. My account number is 17721077 and my date of birth is 03/05/1970.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Patel. I have your account open. Can you tell me me more about the charge you're disputing?
Customer: I'm James Patel, and I'm seeing a fifty dollar overcharge for a data package I never signed up for. I live at 460 MG Road and I've never had any issues with my plan until now.
Agent: I see the charge here. It looks like a system error applied a premium data add-on to your line. I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge right now.
Agent: Please be aware that this credit is subject to approval and typically takes 7-10 business days to appear on your statement.
Customer: Okay, that sounds fair. I just wanted it fixed. Can you confirm my phone number on file is 93996 40865?
Agent: Yes, that is correct. The request has been submitted. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Customer: No, that's all. Thank you for sorting this out so quickly, Arjun. I appreciate it.
Agent: You're very welcome. To summarize, I've requested a refund for the data charge which should be processed in 7-10 business days. Thank you for choosing Nimbus Telecom. Goodbye!
